name: Cloud Catalogue for WooCommerce
author: cloudcatalogue

sections.description:
Create professional product catalogs, wholesale line sheets and sell sheets using your existing WooCommerce products.

Cloud Catalogue makes it easier to prepare and share your product information with retailers. Import products from WooCommerce, choose a layout and create professional PDFs without rebuilding your product information from scratch.

Need to share a catalog directly with buyers? With eligible plans, you can also send private online catalog links where retailers can browse products, view their wholesale pricing and submit order requests.

Explore Cloud Catalogue | Try a Sample Catalog | Pricing & Plans | Getting Started | Support

Create catalogs, line sheets and sell sheets

  • Choose from three catalog layouts for different product categories and presentation styles.
  • Create one-page sell sheets to highlight individual products.
  • Include product photos, descriptions, SKUs and pricing.
  • Download professional PDFs for sharing, printing or sales presentations.

Share private catalogs with retail buyers

On Wholesale and Growth plans:

  • Share private online catalogs directly with buyers.
  • Tailor product assortments and wholesale pricing.
  • Let buyers select products and quantities.
  • Receive wholesale order requests for review.
  • Arrange invoicing and payment directly with buyers.

Cloud Catalogue collects order requests, not payments, and does not automatically create WooCommerce orders.

Import products from WooCommerce

Connect your existing WooCommerce store and select the products you want to import.

Cloud Catalogue uses read-only access to retrieve supported product information, including images, descriptions, SKUs, variations and retail prices. Your WooCommerce listings remain unchanged.

Reuse product information

Build a product library that makes it easier to create additional catalogs, line sheets and sell sheets without repeatedly entering the same information.

When linked product details change, you can review and apply updates to your catalogs.

Create sales materials for your business

Cloud Catalogue is designed for brands, manufacturers, wholesalers and sales teams working with products such as apparel, beauty, jewelry, accessories, home goods, food and beverages.

Free plugin, hosted platform

The WordPress plugin is free to install and connects your WooCommerce store to Cloud Catalogue.

Catalog creation, PDF generation, product management and private buyer catalogs are provided through the Cloud Catalogue web application.

Cloud Catalogue offers Studio, Wholesale and Growth subscriptions, as well as an eligible 14-day Studio trial.

WooCommerce imports are available to eligible paid subscribers, authorized complimentary accounts and eligible active #TRYCLOUD trials, subject to account limits.

Private buyer links and wholesale order requests require Wholesale or Growth.

Installing the plugin does not grant a plan, unlock paid features or start a trial. See Pricing & Plans for current plan details.

Independent integration

Cloud Catalogue is a product of Raw Guild Studios, LLC. This is an independently developed integration. It is not a WooCommerce Marketplace product and is not endorsed by WooCommerce, WordPress or Automattic.

External service and data use

This plugin connects to an external service.

  • Service: Cloud Catalogue, https://www.cloudcatalogue.co, operated by Raw Guild Studios, LLC.
  • Terms: https://www.cloudcatalogue.co/terms
  • Privacy: https://www.cloudcatalogue.co/privacy
  • Support: hello@cloudcatalogue.co

What the plugin itself does: it provides local setup checks, shows matching WooCommerce Read authorization metadata for the current administrator, and opens the hosted Cloud Catalogue setup, product review and account screens after you confirm consent. It does not import products locally, write to your store, schedule syncing, create webhooks or process customer or order data. It makes no remote HTTP requests, tracking or automatic external calls.

What is sent, and when: only a deliberate administrator click opens the hosted site. No store URL, email, account identifier or credential is appended by the plugin. Your browser sends ordinary web requests to that site. Sign in there and enter your store URL. After a separate WooCommerce authorization approval, WooCommerce sends a generated Read REST key directly to Cloud Catalogue’s existing signed callback.

How data is used: Cloud Catalogue encrypts its stored key and uses permitted product and variation fields (including SKU, descriptions, retail prices, attributes and available product stock fields) and supported images for imports you review. Read is WooCommerce’s store-wide scope, not a product-only API permission; the service does not request customers or orders and does not use write endpoints.

Credentials: no Cloud Catalogue secret, key, token, password, email or account ID is stored in plugin options. WooCommerce itself stores the native REST credentials. The plugin reads key IDs, descriptions and permission metadata locally, not credential values. WooCommerce and Cloud Catalogue authorization remain authoritative. Product data is fetched by the hosted read-only service, not the plugin. No analytics, remote code, remote assets or ads are included.

Local status is not verified hosted account or connection status. Key descriptions are editable labels, not proof of account association. Only matching read-only metadata belonging to your current WordPress user is shown. Review the full native WooCommerce REST API list for authorizations from other users.

Disconnect and deletion

Disconnect first in Cloud Catalogue → Store imports; then revoke the matching key in WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API. Disconnect removes the saved key in Cloud Catalogue, not your imported products, photos, catalogs or subscription. Deactivating or deleting this connector does not revoke WooCommerce keys, delete hosted content or cancel billing. Manage billing separately in your Cloud Catalogue account. Uninstalling has no destructive side effects because this plugin stores no data.
sections.installation:
How to get started

  1. Install and activate the free Cloud Catalogue for WooCommerce plugin.
  2. Open Settings → Cloud Catalogue in WordPress.
  3. Select Open store setup and sign in to Cloud Catalogue.
  4. Authorize read-only WooCommerce access.
  5. Choose your products and import them into Cloud Catalogue.
  6. Create your catalog, line sheet or sell sheet.

Customers can also start the WooCommerce connection from the Integrations section of their Cloud Catalogue account.

Requirements and details

  • WooCommerce 9.0 or later, WordPress 6.5 or later and PHP 7.4 or later. A currently maintained PHP version is recommended.
  • Your store address must use HTTPS; non-HTTPS addresses are refused.
  • On the settings page, review the HTTPS, permalink and WooCommerce readiness checks. These checks do not test public network reachability.
  • Before opening Cloud Catalogue, read the external-service disclosure and tick the consent box.
  • When signed in to Cloud Catalogue, enter the store address shown in WordPress, then approve Read access on WooCommerce’s own authorization screen.
  • Imports are previewed and approved in Cloud Catalogue’s Store imports screen. Return to the plugin settings page to see local authorization metadata.
  • Hosted imports work for eligible paid subscribers, authorized complimentary accounts and eligible active #TRYCLOUD Studio trials, within each account’s limits. The plugin itself does not decide or grant access.
sections.faq:
Do I need to recreate my WooCommerce products?

No. You can import supported product information from your existing store and review the products you want to use.

Can I send catalogs directly to retailers?

Yes. You can share downloadable PDFs. Wholesale and Growth plans also allow private online catalog links.

Can retailers submit wholesale orders?

Retailers can submit wholesale order requests through eligible private catalogs. Merchants review those requests and arrange payment separately.

Does Cloud Catalogue change my WooCommerce store?

No. The integration uses read-only access and does not modify WooCommerce products or create orders.

Do I need WooCommerce to use Cloud Catalogue?

No. Cloud Catalogue also supports manually adding products and importing CSV files.

Is the WordPress plugin free?

Yes. The connector is free to install. Access to the hosted Cloud Catalogue features depends on your subscription or trial eligibility.

Where can I find pricing, setup help and support?

Visit the Cloud Catalogue website for plans, getting-started instructions and customer support, or email hello@cloudcatalogue.co.

Does this install the catalog designer in WordPress?

No. Catalog creation, PDFs and reviewed imports run in the hosted Cloud Catalogue service.

Do I need another credential or API scope?

No. The native WooCommerce Read authorization is reused. There is no plugin-to-service status token, callback or custom login system.

Is this an official WooCommerce Marketplace product?

No. This is an independent connector published by Raw Guild Studios, LLC. It is not a WooCommerce Marketplace product and is not endorsed by WooCommerce or Automattic.

Does installing cancel or change my subscription?

No. The connector neither grants access nor modifies billing. Existing direct subscriptions remain independent of any future Marketplace billing.
